text: DSH Chrome Bridge 是供 DSH Web 使用的浏览器控制插件，包含 Host 服务、工具和 Chrome 扩展。它用本机 WebSocket 连接已登录的 Chromium，并按会话管理标签页；新域名可先请求用户许可。agent 能导航、读取页面文字和无障碍快照、执行 JavaScript、点击、输入、截图及批量调用操作。侧边栏显示连接状态和域名授权；截图通过附件服务返回，或保存到工作区。使用时需在 DSH 加载插件并安装随包扩展；默认连接 127.0.0.1:8765，无需外部 API key。

DSH Chrome Bridge connects DSH Web agents to signed-in Chromium through a local Host service and extension. Agents can read, navigate, click, type, and capture screenshots, with session tabs and optional domain approval. Install both components; no external API key is needed.

DSH Chrome Bridge 的功能「浏览器页面操作」：agent 可在已登录的 Chrome 中导航到网页，读取页面文字或无障碍快照，并通过点击、键盘输入和 JavaScript 求值与页面交互；首次访问域名可请求用户批准。
DSH Chrome Bridge 的功能「批量操作与截图」：agent 可将有序的浏览器工具步骤合并为一次调用，也可截取当前视口、整页或指定区域；截图进入附件服务，缺少该服务时保存到工作区。
DSH Chrome Bridge lets agents browse signed-in Chrome tabs, grouped by session, with optional domain approval.

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Agent 操作你**真实、已登录的 Chromium 浏览器**。
思路对齐 OpenAI Codex 的 Chrome 扩展：浏览器里装一个小扩展作为桥，Agent 通过它在
专用标签组里开页、读页、点击、输入、截图；第一次接触某个域名时先征求你的批准。

- **零依赖扩展**：Manifest V3，只用 `chrome.*` API，不打包第三方运行时。
- **纯插件挂载**：无构建步骤，Host 半身是普通 ESM。
- **本机闭环**：扩展只主动连 `ws://127.0.0.1`，不监听端口、不暴露给网页。

dsh-chrome-bridge README · 功能特性：| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 真实浏览器操作 | 打开/导航标签页、读页面文本、执行 JS、截图 |
| 真实鼠标键盘 | 选择器或坐标点击（支持双击/右键）、文本输入、按键与组合键（CDP `Input` 域） |
| 按域名授权 | 首次接触域名弹出「本次会话允许 / 始终允许 / 拒绝」；始终允许经 settings 服务持久化 |
| 会话级标签组 | 每个 Agent 会话独立 `DSH · <会话标识>` 标签组，多会话并行互不干扰 |
| 标签页自动回收 | 默认**复用当前会话标签页**；每会话最多保留 `maxSessionTabs` 个，超出按 LRU 自动关闭；空闲超时与会话结束时自动清理 |
| 标签组配色与命名 | 每个会话按哈希分配固定颜色；组名默认取首个页面标题，Agent 可用 `chrome_group` 改为简短目的名 |
| AX 快照 | `chrome_snapshot` 返回带层级、可见状态和稳定 `e1` 引用的无障碍树；默认输出增量 diff，`tab.ax.write()` 自动把状态/截图回传模型 |
| 批量动作（省往返） | `chrome_act` 一次工具调用按顺序执行多个动作并回传每次观察；`chrome_js` 提供持久 Codex 风格浏览器会话 |
| 虚拟光标 | 使用官方 `cursor-chat.png` 资源，隔离于页面样式；读页时显示，当前回合结束时收起 |
| 滚动页面 | `chrome_scroll` 按目标框或视口尺寸翻页，支持四个方向；像素滚动使用 Chrome 原生手势 |
| 截图直回对话 | PNG 经附件管线作为图像内容块直接给模型；无附件服务时回退为工作区文件 |
| 侧栏面板 | 右侧栏「+」菜单 → Chrome 桥接：连接状态、安装引导、域名名单 |
| 安全边界 | `blockedDomains` 永远拒绝；只能关闭 Agent 标签组内的页 |

dsh-chrome-bridge README · 1. 安装 DSH 插件：在 DSH 会话里让 Agent 执行 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，目标为本目录的绝对路径；
或在终端：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-chrome-bridge
```

这会挂载两个 Host 级行：

- `chrome-bridge`：桥接服务（WebSocket 服务器）
- `chrome-bridge-tools`：`chrome_*` 工具

**装好后刷新一次 Web 页面**，右侧栏「+」菜单里才会出现「Chrome 桥接」标签页。

dsh-chrome-bridge README · 2. 安装 Chrome / Edge 扩展：1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`（Edge 为 `edge://extensions`），开启「开发者模式」。
2. 点「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择本包的 `extension/` 目录
   （侧栏面板里可一键复制该路径）。
3. 点扩展图标，确认显示 **Connected to DSH**（端口默认 `8765`，需与服务端一致）。

dsh-chrome-bridge README · DSH Chrome Bridge：Let DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents operate your **real, signed-in Chromium
browser**. The design follows OpenAI's Codex Chrome extension: a small
extension in your browser acts as a bridge, and the agent opens pages, reads
them, clicks, types, and takes screenshots in a dedicated tab group — asking
for your approval the first time it touches a new domain.

dsh-chrome-bridge README · DSH Chrome Bridge：- **Dependency-free extension**: Manifest V3, only `chrome.*` APIs, no
  third-party runtime bundled.
- **Pure plugin mount**: no build step; the Host half is plain ESM.
- **Local-only loop**: the extension only dials `ws://127.0.0.1`; it never
  listens on a port and no web page can reach it.

dsh-chrome-bridge README · Features：| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| Real browser control | Open/navigate tabs, read visible text, evaluate JS, screenshots |
| Real mouse & keyboard | Selector or coordinate clicks (double click, right/middle button), text input, key presses with modifiers (CDP `Input` domain) |
| Per-domain approval | First visit to a domain asks "allow this session / always allow / decline"; "always" persists through the DSH settings service |
| Per-session tab groups | Each agent session gets its own `DSH · <session>` group, so concurrent sessions never collide |
| Automatic tab recycling | Reuses the session's current tab by default; keeps at most `maxSessionTabs` tabs per session (LRU eviction), closes idle tabs and everything on session end |
| Group colors and names | Each session gets a stable palette color; the group defaults to the first page's title and the agent can rename it to a short purpose with `chrome_group` |
| AX snapshots | `chrome_snapshot` returns a hierarchical accessibility tree with visibility and stable `e1` refs; output is an incremental diff by default and `tab.ax.write()` emits state/screenshots to the model |

dsh-chrome-bridge README · Security model：- The extension is outbound-only: it dials `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>`, never
  listens, and no web page can reach it.
- The server binds loopback by default. Any local process can still connect to
  the port, so set `authToken` if local-process isolation matters.
- While attached via `chrome.debugger`, Chromium shows its standard "is
  debugging this browser" banner; this is required to read and drive pages.
- Domain approval gates navigation and page interaction (read/eval/click/type/
  screenshot); `blockedDomains` always wins.
- Only tabs inside agent DSH tab groups can be closed by the agent.
- See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for private reporting.

The unit tests resolve `@deepseek-ai/*` packages from a DSH installation; when

dsh-chrome-bridge README · Known limitations：- Requires the browser extension and `chrome.debugger`; Chromium-only
  (Chrome/Edge/Chromium).
- Tab groups are per session; all tabs of one session share a single group.
- Without an attachment service (minimal compositions), screenshots fall back
  to workspace files plus `read_image`.
- Experimental; the private protocol is v1 and may change between releases.
